spans.s:
रट् {c1c} P. (रटति, रटित)
1 To
shout, scream, yell, cry, roar,
howl; घोराश्चारटिषुः शिवाः

; पपात राक्षसो भूमौ रराट च भयंकरं
14. 81.
--2 To call out, proclaim
loudly.
--3 To shout with joy,
applaud.

रटनं [रट् ल्युट्]
1 The act of
crying, screaming or shouting.
--2 A
shout of applause, approbation.

रटंती N. of the fourteenth day in
the dark half of Māgha.
रटितं A scream, shout, yell, cry;
